resale_co.name: Housing inspection (CO inspection) for home sales
resale_co.issued_by: Mantua Township Fire District, under a shared services agreement with the Borough (effective March 1, 2026)
resale_co.lead_time: Apply 10 or more business days before closing for the standard fee. 4 to 9 business days and 3 or fewer business days cost more. Payment in full is required before the inspection is scheduled.

fees.label: Standard, application received 10 or more business days before closing
fees.quote: Standard (Application received 10 or more business days prior to closing/occupancy): $90.00.

fees.label: Expedited, application received 4 to 9 business days before closing
fees.quote: Expedited (Application received 4 to 9 business days prior to closing/occupancy): $140.00.

fees.label: Emergency, application received 3 or fewer business days before closing
fees.quote: Emergency (Application received 3 or fewer business days prior to closing/occupancy) $200.00.

fees.label: Re-inspection, each inspection after the first failed one
fees.quote: Re-Inspection Fee (Required for each subsequent inspection after the first failed inspection): $40.00.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the Borough of Wenonah Fire Safety Application on the Mantua Township Fire District website, pay in full (check, money order, or the district's online payment link at https://www.velocitypayment.com/client/mtfd/index.html), then call the fire district at (856) 468-7222 ext. 102 and ask for Daniel Hauss, Fire Official, to schedule.

evidence.quote: Effective March 1, 2026, Mantua Township Fire District will handle Wenonah’s housing inspections (Co-Inspections) as part of a shared services agreement.
This includes all inspections required for sales of homes and rental properties.

resale_co.notes: Borough page last updated May 8, 2026. It links to the application through an Outlook safelinks wrapper; the real address is mtfd22.com/wenonah-housing-insepctions/ (spelled that way on the site). The fire district website is behind a bot check and could not be read, so the pre-inspection checklist, what is inspected, and how long the certificate is valid were not confirmed. Construction permits and zoning for Wenonah go through Mantua Township (401 Main Street, Mantua, 856-468-1500).

authorities.name: Mantua Township Fire District (handles Wenonah housing and fire safety inspections under a shared services agreement)
authorities.lead_time: Same tiers as the housing inspection: 10 or more business days before closing for the standard fee.
authorities.how_to_apply: Same application and scheduling as the housing inspection: the Borough of Wenonah Fire Safety Application on the fire district website, then call (856) 468-7222 ext. 102. No separate smoke certificate fee is published; the Borough lists one fee schedule (see resale_co fees).

evidence.quote: You will be required to complete a form that can be found online at Borough of Wenonah Fire Safety Application

fire_cert.notes: The Borough calls the fire district form a 'Fire Safety Application' and names a Fire Official as the contact, which suggests the smoke alarm, CO alarm and extinguisher check is part of the same inspection, but no official page says so directly. Conflict: the NJ DCA LEA Registry (July 2026, as of June 30, 2026) still lists 'C Wenonah Borough' (C = County, meaning the Gloucester County Fire Marshal's Office is the fire code enforcing agency), and the County Fire Marshal page also lists Wenonah. County Fire Marshal: 856-307-7912, gcfmo@co.gloucester.nj.us. The Wenonah Volunteer Fire Company is the suppression company, not an inspecting agency.
